reason: Document A goes straight at my belief that the renovation drove the scores: it shows the score had already risen from 7.9 to 8.2 before the renovation began. It also gives concrete results from the seven weeks she covered the job (no uncovered shifts, overtime under plan), a specific plan for the budget gap (finance course, weekly sessions with Ben), and an honest comparison with the outside candidate. Document B is full of placeholders, mostly concedes the renovation point, and offers a vaguer budget plan.
